# James R. McCarthy (Jim McCarthy)

> AI-native operating models produce startup build velocity at incumbent scale. Builder and product roles are converging. A small team with the right stack outruns a large team on legacy process.

James R. McCarthy (Jim McCarthy) is President of Case FMS, a leading provider of exterior facility maintenance services across the United States and Canada, with more than 35,000 client locations. He is responsible for operational execution, the company's growth, and its proprietary technology. He writes about the operating work, the tools, golf with his son, and care at home. The AI essays argue decision velocity: now that building is nearly free, the scarce resource is the speed and judgment of deciding.
